parts.text: I keep drones and charging equipment in working order, which includes adding new ones to the fleet, retiring old ones, setting up charging pads at our sites, taking drones out of service for repairs and putting them back, and sending drones to charge. Regulators can ask us to show how our drones have been looked after. Sometimes drones restart in flight after a software fault and carry on, which worries me given how patchy radio coverage and unreliable links can be when we try to manage equipment and instructions in the field.
